blockers.detail: M makes ntpd/nts_client.c::nts_check() call dns_take_pool(peer, &sockaddr) for the first time (previously the function existed but was never referenced); the harness setup.c only stubs dns_take_server and dns_take_status, so the link fails with an undefined reference to dns_take_pool

evidence: M diff (32a950f65, verified via .patch): ntpd/nts_client.c nts_check() now branches on MDF_POOL and calls dns_take_pool(peer, &sockaddr); include/ntp_dns.h adds DNS_NTS_pool to the DNS_Status enum
The dns_take_pool function body already existed before M (its hunk header appears as context in M's diff); M is what first references it from nts_client.c
h(M^1) setup.c (oss-fuzz rev aa7bc69268b9) contains zero occurrences of dns_take_pool - it only defines dns_take_server and dns_take_status
H diff (56131750d, verified via .patch) adds exactly 7 lines to projects/ntpsec/fuzz/setup.c: one declaration plus a stub definition for dns_take_pool

h(M^1) FuzzServer.c still calls nts_ke_process_receive(&buf, &aead) with 2 args, and M does not touch that signature, so the api failure in this sample is purely the missing symbol - not an argument-count change

rationale.zh: M 让库第一次引用 `dns_take_pool`：`ntpd/nts_client.c` 的 `nts_check()` 新增了 `if (peer->cast_flags & MDF_POOL)` 分支，在 NTS+pool 场景下调用 `dns_take_pool(peer, &sockaddr)`（该函数体此前已存在，但无人调用），同时 `include/ntp_dns.h` 的 `DNS_Status` 枚举新增 `DNS_NTS_pool`。harness 的 `setup.c` 是专门提供 daemon 符号 stub、避免链接 `libntpd_lib.a` 的，它的符号集合只有 `dns_take_server` 和 `dns_take_status`，没有跟上这次新引用，于是链接阶段报 `dns_take_pool` 未定义。修复 H 只做一件事：在 `setup.c` 里补上 `dns_take_pool` 的声明与空实现（7 行），构建即恢复。属于本次引入的显式 api 退化（单一缺失符号，不涉及签名变更或链接顺序）。
rationale.en: M makes the library reference dns_take_pool for the first time: ntpd/nts_client.c's nts_check() gains an MDF_POOL branch that calls dns_take_pool(peer, &sockaddr) for NTS pools (the function body already existed but had no callers), and include/ntp_dns.h adds DNS_NTS_pool to the DNS_Status enum. The harness setup.c exists specifically to stub daemon symbols so the link does not pull in libntpd_lib.a, and its stub set covers only dns_take_server and dns_take_status, so it misses the new reference and the link fails on an undefined dns_take_pool. Fix H does one thing: it adds the declaration plus an empty definition of dns_take_pool to setup.c (7 lines) and the build recovers. This is an explicit api degradation introduced by this change, a single missing symbol with no signature change and no link-order component.
